title: The Pitcher's Mitt's light gravity lasts one step for a rock
description: Wearing a pitcher's mitt, the player throws a rock straight ahead: it drops to the floor within a few steps and stops short. He throws a jar the same way: it keeps the mitt's light gravity and flies flat across the room.
